description: Stop the dp-prod cluster when nobody and no fixed job needs it, and start it 30 min before the next window.
change: Auto-stop/auto-start schedule: working days on 01:30-20:00, weekends/holidays on 01:30-08:00; always on during the last 3 working days of the month and on working days in January, and from 00:00 the morning after such a day (month-end close runs until ~04:00, year-end close until ~02:00); ad-hoc queries auto-resume the cluster. From next month.
risks_and_exceptions: Protection windows respected: W1 Month-end close (finance) (Last 3 working days of each month, 18:00 until about 04:00 next morning); W2 Year-end close analysis (January) (Every working day in January, 20:00 for about 6 h); W3 Nightly data jobs incl. weekends (Daily 02:00-07:30 (ETL done by 06:00, PBI refresh by 07:30); reporting export by 08:00 on working days). Rule engine: schedule checked against 1,894 protected job runs/days, 0 conflicts. Evening ad-hoc analysis waits 5-10 min for auto-resume. Platform grows to 24 nodes from Oct 2026 (T-1261), which raises the saving. Must be approved by both heads before go-live; first month monitored daily. Decision by: Head of Consulting (owner) + Head of Finance (month-end/year-end) (responsible per mapping: Head of Consulting).
assumptions_and_sources: 35% of runtime hours removed (55,518 node-h); price CHF 0.537/node-h from azure_costs.csv; off-hours energy at 5 % CPU (CCF model, 16 vCPU + 64 GB per node). Conservative cost: 20 % of off-hours re-used via auto-resume. Ranges: CHF 23,832-29,790; kg CO2 147-892 (low/high factors).

description: Pause dp-dev when idle and outside working hours, with an automatic start for the quarterly training.
change: Auto-termination after 30 min idle; schedule on working days 08:00-18:00; fully on days 1-3 of Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct (auto-start at 00:00, 'pre-heated' 30 min before). Move the flexible 'Test data refresh' from 17:00 to 16:00 so it ends inside the window (rule engine: 83 runs overran 18:00). From next month.
risks_and_exceptions: Protection windows respected: W4 Quarterly model training (Days 1-3 of January, April, July, October, continuously; must start automatically). Rule engine: schedule checked against 21 protected job runs/days, 0 conflicts. Developers wait a few minutes after a pause. The training start must be tested before the next quarter (1 January). Criticality 'low' in master data contradicts the training dependency: a human confirms. Decision by: Head of IT (responsible per mapping: Head of IT).
assumptions_and_sources: 47,552 node-h/year removed; price CHF 0.551/node-h (EUR converted); active use only 9% of runtime. Ranges: CHF 20,953-26,191; kg CO2 702-2,892 (low/high factors).

description: Re-create dp-dev in Azure Switzerland North next to dp-prod (ticket T-1074: technically possible).
change: Infrastructure-as-code redeploy in Zurich, copy dev data, switch endpoints; do it in May or June (outside the training window W4).
risks_and_exceptions: Protection windows respected: W4 Quarterly model training (Days 1-3 of January, April, July, October, continuously; must start automatically). Migration risk (dev only, no production impact). Dev data stays in Switzerland (sovereignty plus). Do not migrate in the first week of a quarter. Decision by: Head of IT (responsible per mapping: Head of IT).
assumptions_and_sources: CO2 = remaining dp-dev energy after M2 x (grid DE - grid CH). Price Zurich CHF 0.537 vs Frankfurt CHF 0.551 per node-h (invoices): cost change CHF 312/year. Ranges: CHF 0-312; kg CO2 304-1,121 (low/high factors).

risks_and_exceptions: Protection windows respected: W4 Quarterly model training (Days 1-3 of January, April, July, October, continuously; must start automatically). AI pilot P-004 ended 2025-06-30 and the last human login was 2026-07-03: ask the owner whether the server is still needed at all (would save the rest too). description: Shrink vm-test from 64 to 16 vCPU as planned in T-1058 after the portal go-live, incl. 3 forgotten servers.

description: Route classification, summaries and translations to a small model; keep large models for contracts, analysis and drafting.
change: Gateway routing rule by task_type: Classify (marketing script), Summarise and Translate -> small model (e.g. GPT-5.4 mini / Claude Haiku, or Swiss-hosted Apertus 8B as an option); enable prompt caching for the marketing script (0 % cached today). After a 1-week A/B quality check.
